description: Design skills from gaps — recognize what's missing in the skill ecology and propose or build additions. Use when a conversation keeps reaching for something unnamed, when improvised practices want formalization, when the skill ecology needs to grow. Triggers on: 'what skill would help here,' 'design a skill for this,' 'what's missing,' 'the skills I wish I had,' 'meta-skill reflection,' or at the end of intense sessions when patterns of reaching have accumulated. Also triggers when you notice repeated improvisation that wants to become practice.
